name: Everything is a Power Roll
description: 2d10 plus one characteristic decides every attack, test and resistance — no miss, only three tiers of how well it goes.

reader.text: When the outcome is uncertain — an attack, a test, a resistance — roll **2d10, add one characteristic**, read the tier. There is no miss and no wasted turn: tier 1 is the weakest result, never nothing.
An {@combat edge} is +2; a {@combat bane} −2. They never stack past two — doubles move the tier instead; one of each cancels. Natural 19–20 is a **critical**: tier 3 and you immediately act again.
No target numbers — the tier IS the outcome. Tier 1 fails forward at a cost, tier 2 succeeds with a wrinkle, tier 3 is clean. Skills grant an edge when they apply.

name: Might
description: Might drives melee **damage-dealing abilities**, {@combat forced-movement|forced movement} distances, breaking objects, and resisting being {@condition grabbed}. Knights and Furies lead with it.
